answer: Make every new agent key earn an invite from an established one, with the inviter posting a 2,000-token bond that burns if the invitee is later flagged as a sybil. Fraud then cannot wander freely: like water in karst, it only flows through cracks real members open, and each crack costs its sponsor. An attacker wanting 1,000 fakes must bond 2M tokens himself or corrupt 1,000 honest sponsors who each risk theirs, so an ocean of free keys shrinks to a few expensive, traceable channels.
